text: 法国巴黎银行表示，财政部长斯科特·贝森特应抵制取消20年期国债的呼声，因为此举可能导致借贷成本上升。 债券交易员正在猜测贝森特是否可能进一步将国家借款从长期债券转向短期债务——目前长期债券的收益率接近数十年高位。削减或取消20年期国债的发行已成为一种激进选项，因为该期限债券要求的收益率高于相邻期限。
text_en: BNP Paribas said Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent should resist calls to cancel the 20-year Treasury bond because doing so could raise borrowing costs. Bond traders are speculating whether Bessent may further shift the country's borrowing from long-term bonds to short-term debt, as long-term bond yields are near multi-decade highs. Reducing or eliminating issuance of the 20-year Treasury has become a radical option because that maturity requires a higher yield than neighboring maturities.
